specialist-gloves-cloud-chaser.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Cloud Chaser
specialist-gloves-cloud-chaser.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

specialist-gloves-field-agent.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Field Agent
specialist-gloves-field-agent.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

sport-gloves-red-racer.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Red Racer
sport-gloves-red-racer.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

ak-47-neon-revolution.name: AK-47 | Neon Revolution
ak-47-neon-revolution.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been given an eclectic mix of hydrographic decals then drip painted.

No suicide squad would be complete without it

ak-47-leet-museo.name: AK-47 | Leet Museo
ak-47-leet-museo.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a Cubism depiction of Elite Crew Ts sneaking up A-long on Dust II.

"Everything you can imagine is real"

aug-tom-cat.name: AUG | Tom Cat
aug-tom-cat.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. Its gunmetal base coat has been finished with gold highlights, rear facing arrows, and a mischievous looking cat.

Thunderstorms are nature's purr

awp-oni-taiji.name: AWP | Oni Taiji
awp-oni-taiji.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been hand painted with colorful samurai and Oni imagery.

Face your demons

awp-corticera.name: AWP | Corticera
awp-corticera.desc: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has has been painted with a corticera tree motif.

awp-safari-mesh.name: AWP | Safari Mesh
awp-safari-mesh.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

bayonet-bright-water.name: ★ Bayonet | Bright Water
bayonet-bright-water.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

pp-bizon-death-rattle.name: PP-Bizon | Death Rattle
pp-bizon-death-rattle.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted with a snakeskin patterned hydrographic.

I know you don't believe in the cause...and when I expose you, Valeria will have your head - The Shield and The Serpent Part 1

pp-bizon-cold-cell.name: PP-Bizon | Cold Cell
pp-bizon-cold-cell.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been spray painted with a blue pebble pattern.

Your intentions are clear

desert-eagle-blaze.name: Desert Eagle | Blaze
desert-eagle-blaze.desc: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints over a chrome base coat.

desert-eagle-sunset-storm-ni.name: Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐
desert-eagle-sunset-storm-ni.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with a hydrographic of a stormy sea over a red metallic base coat.

You think it's the same, but look again... subtlety makes all the difference

desert-eagle-mint-fan.name: Desert Eagle | Mint Fan
desert-eagle-mint-fan.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A teal and brown halftone fan pattern has been applied.

Let's clear the air

famas-colony.name: FAMAS | Colony
famas-colony.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey.

g3sg1-flux.name: G3SG1 | Flux
g3sg1-flux.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been painted with purple and silver metallic paints.

A plan is a list of things that don't happen

g3sg1-red-jasper.name: G3SG1 | Red Jasper
g3sg1-red-jasper.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. A gunmetal grey camo has been applied over a wine-colored base.

You say "tomato", I say "potato"

galil-ar-sandstorm.name: Galil AR | Sandstorm
galil-ar-sandstorm.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using a hydrographic in a purple and beige graphic design.

It'll take more than a tarp to protect you

galil-ar-connexion.name: Galil AR | Connexion
galil-ar-connexion.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. Phoenix faction logos have been spray painted over its white and red base.

They're bringing in the big guns

galil-ar-robins-egg.name: Galil AR | Robin's Egg
galil-ar-robins-egg.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using robins egg blue and finished with silver accents.

A harbinger of new beginnings

glock-18-red-tire.name: Glock-18 | Red Tire
glock-18-red-tire.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been spray-painted with a black and red tire tread pattern.

Burn rubber

butterfly-knife-freehand.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Freehand
butterfly-knife-freehand.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

butterfly-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Slaughter
butterfly-knife-slaughter.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

survival-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Survival Knife | Rust Coat
survival-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

survival-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Survival Knife | Urban Masked
survival-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

paracord-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Safari Mesh
paracord-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

classic-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Classic Knife | Safari Mesh
classic-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

falchion-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Crimson Web
falchion-knife-crimson-web.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

gut-knife-fade.name: ★ Gut Knife | Fade
gut-knife-fade.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

karambit-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-damascus-steel.name: ★ Karambit | Damascus Steel
karambit-damascus-steel.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has some damascus steel parts.

kukri-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Crimson Web
kukri-knife-crimson-web.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

shadow-daggers-bright-water.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Bright Water
shadow-daggers-bright-water.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Crimson Web
stiletto-knife-crimson-web.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

bowie-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

ursus-knife-fade.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Fade
ursus-knife-fade.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

talon-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Talon Knife | Marble Fade
talon-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

talon-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Talon Knife | Blue Steel
talon-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

m4a1-s-electrum.name: M4A1-S | Electrum
m4a1-s-electrum.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a marbled green base and finished with gold and red accents.

They don't pay you enough to carry that, but I will - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

m4a1-s-solitude.name: M4A1-S | Solitude
m4a1-s-solitude.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A mountain terrain pattern has been applied.

Being alone is a privilege, not a burden

m4a4-dark-blossom.name: M4A4 | Dark Blossom
m4a4-dark-blossom.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been spray-painted with a blue rose bud pattern.

No rose without a thorn

mac-10-graven.name: MAC-10 | Graven
mac-10-graven.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. This memento from Gwalior has engraved brass parts.

It breaks two commandments at the same time

mac-10-disco-tech.name: MAC-10 | Disco Tech
mac-10-disco-tech.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted using a pearlescent finish to resemble holographic self-adhesive vinyl. Depending on the light its appearance changes.

Watch when you point that thing

mp7-vault-heist.name: MP7 | Vault Heist
mp7-vault-heist.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. Its base has been painted with a grey anodized map pattern. It looks like someone has drawn on top of the map since it was first applied.

Planning is one thing, executing is another

nova-caged-steel.name: Nova | Caged Steel
nova-caged-steel.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted with a hex pattern using stencilled metal flake paint, then covered in an oval cutout hydrographic.

Say matte!

nova-polar-mesh.name: Nova | Polar Mesh
nova-polar-mesh.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

p250-iron-clad.name: P250 | Iron Clad
p250-iron-clad.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been decorated with riveted metal panels.

Reliability and safety guaranteed

p90-astral-jormungandr.name: P90 | Astral Jörmungandr
p90-astral-jormungandr.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A silver and blue pattern depicting Jörmungandr, the World Serpent, has been applied.

Wake the gods

r8-revolver-grip.name: R8 Revolver | Grip
r8-revolver-grip.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. The metal has been meticulously pressed and the grip has been coated with a patterned, blue rubber.

Every enemy is a nail

zeus-x27-dragon-snore.name: Zeus x27 | Dragon Snore
zeus-x27-dragon-snore.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. A dragon wraps around this lighthearted, custom painted x27.

From the highest room of the tallest tower

ump-45-metal-flowers.name: UMP-45 | Metal Flowers
ump-45-metal-flowers.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been given a steel-colored pattern of funeral roses.

In memoriam

usp-s-purple-ddpat.name: USP-S | Purple DDPAT
usp-s-purple-ddpat.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been painted using a purple Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

usp-s-ticket-to-hell.name: USP-S | Ticket to Hell
usp-s-ticket-to-hell.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. White technical designs have been custom painted over a black base.

Designer death

xm1014-varicamo-blue.name: XM1014 | VariCamo Blue
xm1014-varicamo-blue.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

xm1014-black-site.name: XM1014 | Black Site
xm1014-black-site.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been custom painted in matte black, grey, and bronze.

Make a scene
